llm_response.reason: The website shows a significant mismatch in branding and content. It presents itself as a construction specialist ('Avantbuild Spesialis Konstruksi Modern & Inovatif') yet features detailed e-commerce functionality, product categories, low-priced offers, and references to Lazada. This inconsistency, along with the use of promotional and psychological tactics common in scam sites, indicates it is designed to mislead visitors and is likely a scam.
